title.zh: 量测与良率：让工艺形成闭环
title.en: Metrology and yield: close the process loop

subtitle.en: Inline metrology, defect, SPC, WAT and yield

body.zh: 2 Inline量测；输出：厚度/ CD / Overlay；Thickness；CD；Overlay
body.en: 2 Inline metrology Output: thickness / CD / overlay Thickness CD Overlay
3 Defect inspection Output: wafer defect map Critical Major Minor None

body.zh: 4 SPC与风险判断；输出：SPC趋势；UCL；CL；时间
body.en: 4 SPC and risk assessment Output: SPC trend UCL CL Time

body.zh: 5；Containment/；Root Cause；隔离受影响范围；证据链（数据+样品+日志）；根因分析（人/机/料/法/环）；制定并执行缓解措施
body.en: 5 Containment / root cause Contain the affected scope Evidence chain (data + samples + logs) Root-cause analysis (people / machine / material / method / environment) Define and execute mitigation actions

body.zh: 6 WAT与Yield验证；输出：电学表现 ＆ Yield趋势；WAT（例：Id-Vg）；Yield趋势（按Lot）；回到工艺窗口（Process Window）
body.en: 6 WAT and yield validation Output: electrical performance and yield trend WAT (example: Id–Vg) Yield trend (by lot) Return to the process window

body.zh: 1 采样与量测基础；• Sampling；•GRR；•Repeatability；• Reproducibility；重复性；再现性；总变异；目标：量测稳定、可区分过程变化
body.en: 1 Sampling and metrology fundamentals • Sampling • GRR • Repeatability • Reproducibility Repeatability Reproducibility Total variation Goal: stable metrology that distinguishes process changes

body.zh: 2 控制界限要分清；Control Limit：；过程波动判断；Spec Limit：；产品要求；两者不是同一个概念
body.en: 2 Distinguish control boundaries Control limit: assess process variation Specification limit: product requirement These are different concepts

body.zh: 3 关键Trade-off；• Sampling密度 ↑：；检出能力 ↑；Cost与；Cycle Time ↑
body.en: 3 Key trade-offs • Sampling density ↑: detection capability ↑; cost and cycle time ↑

body.zh: • Inline指标异常 ≠；最终器件必然失效
body.en: • An abnormal inline metric ≠ inevitable final-device failure

body.zh: 4 常见失效；False Alarm；异常逃逸；采样盲区；量测漂移；未验证就改Recipe
body.en: 4 Common failures False alarm Escaped anomaly Sampling blind spot Metrology drift Changing the recipe without validation

body.zh: 诊断；证据链；时间趋势；Wafer空间分布；Tool/Chamber分层；独立量测；工程判断；• 复测/离线量测；• 交叉工具验证
body.en: Diagnostic evidence chain Time trend Wafer spatial distribution Tool / chamber stratification Independent metrology Engineering judgment • Remeasure / offline metrology • Cross-tool validation

body.zh: Defect Pareto（示例）；缺陷类型；与特征；缺陷数（相对）；累计占比；缺陷类别
body.en: Defect Pareto (example) Defect types and characteristics Defect count (relative) Cumulative share Defect category

body.zh: Wafer分布特征；随机（Random）；• 离散分布；• 无明显聚集；•可能与颗粒、；环境等相关
body.en: Wafer distribution features Random • Dispersed distribution • No obvious clustering • May relate to particles or the environment

body.zh: 聚集（Cluster）；• 局部聚集；•与设备/工艺；条件/局部缺陷；机制相关
body.en: Cluster • Local clustering • Related to equipment/process conditions or local defect mechanisms

body.zh: 反馈层级：；膜厚/ CD / Overlay/；Profile异常；膜厚/CD/Overlay/Profile → Defect → WAT → Yield；Defect变化；WAT异常；Yield影响趋势
body.en: Feedback hierarchy: Film thickness / CD / overlay / profile anomaly Thickness/CD/overlay/profile → defect → WAT → yield Defect changes WAT anomaly Yield-impact trend

body.zh: 先Contain，确认量测可信度与机制，；再决定后续动作
body.en: Contain first, confirm measurement credibility and mechanism, then determine follow-up actions

body.zh: 影响：；Lot Disposition；Root Cause速度；Yield；Reliability Risk
body.en: Impact: Lot disposition Root-cause speed Yield Reliability risk

body.zh: 采样策略、控制规则和异常处置流程会随产品、量测能力与Fab政策变化。
body.en: Sampling strategy, control rules and abnormality procedures vary with product, metrology capability and fab policy
